title: cli: `os meta delete` declares no `--package`, so the reset door's `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` remedy (name one package) cannot be sent from the CLI, and `os meta register` cannot name the package a save writes into
body:
Filing gate **① a product defect with a named landing point**: a refusal's remedy that the CLI cannot send. Read from source on `main` `3490bf5fa`. Found by the #23293 dev (PR #23349, out-of-scope finding 1) and confirmed by the seat. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · `os-justin` · session `session_01BRQ9Mp1yH7R1az6MaUM18H`. ⛔ Not a claim; grade and lane are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** triage, to grade and route. Both commands are `packages/cli` (`domain:cli`).

## What happens

- Since #23165 (PR #23290), the metadata reset door refuses a delete that names no package of an item that two or more packages hold. It answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, names the packages, and prescribes naming one with `?package=`.
- #23293 (PR #23349) gives the SDK that option: `DeleteMetaItemOptions.packageId`, sent as `?package=`.
- `os meta delete` builds its options bag from its flags in `metaDeleteOptions` (`packages/cli/src/commands/meta/delete.ts:54`). Its flags are `--url`, `--token`, `--format`, `--if-match` and `--draft`, and none names a package. So a CLI user who meets that `409` is told to do something the command cannot send.
- `os meta register` calls `client.meta.saveItem(type, name, metadata)` with no options (`packages/cli/src/commands/meta/register.ts:76`). It cannot name the package a save writes into, although `SaveMetaItemOptions.packageId` has existed since 17.3. Whether a save that names no package is refused for an item two packages hold is **not measured**; this line is for triage to weigh.

## What done looks like

- `os meta delete` takes a `--package` flag (a package id) and forwards it as `packageId` through `metaDeleteOptions`. Add a pin: with two packages holding the item, the command without the flag reports the door's `409`, and with the flag it removes that package's row only.
- `os meta register`: triage decides whether it takes the same flag, forwarded to `saveItem`'s `packageId`.
- **Rides along (from PR #23349's contract review `6157634835`):** the reset door reads five request carriers on `main` (`state`, `dropStorage`, `package`, `If-Match`, and `member`, the last since #22877). The `DeleteMetaItemOptions` header in `packages/client/src/index.ts` says four, and `metaDeleteOptions`' docblock in `packages/cli/src/commands/meta/delete.ts` says three. Both counts are made true here. `member` is absent from every SDK meta method; whether the SDK declares it is outside this card.
- **Depends on:** #23293 (PR #23349), the SDK option the delete flag forwards.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included: `os meta delete package flag cli cannot name package RESOURCE_CONFLICT remedy register package`. 10 hits: #23293 (open; the SDK half) and #23297 (open; three package-axis gaps in `metadata-protocol`), then #22591, #22128, #22135, #22024, #20492, #14937, #12579 and #7705, all closed. None is the CLI's flag.

Dedupe words: os meta delete package flag; cli meta register package; cli RESOURCE_CONFLICT package remedy.
